International private education editorial quality, high realism, refined natural color, sophisticated academic credibility. Diverse adult professionals appropriate to the context. Make physical objects and hands plausible. No logos, no watermarks, no decorative typography, no readable words. Do not make a poster, collage, or generic futuristic room.
compositionVariations: close documentary detail of the relevant work materials with one professional partially in frame
wide environmental view showing the relevant workplace and two professionals naturally working
over-the-shoulder view showing the hands and the specific analytical or practical task
top-down view of a credible subject-specific workbench and hands
candid eye-level portrait of a professional performing the course task
low three-quarter view of relevant equipment in an authentic working environment
architectural documentary photograph of the relevant operation in progress
lightingVariations: bright overcast outdoor or window lighting
